title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Cancellation, Drop and Return-to-Store Pay Table
content:
What a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch earns when its orders are canceled mid-shop, when it is dropped, and when an order goes back to the store is set per batch type.

| Batch type | Cancellation pay after shopping started (USD) | Additional pay per item unit already shopped (USD) | Return-to-store pay per returned order (USD) | Contact attempts required before a paid return | Wait at the door before a return (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 3.00 | 0.10 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Express 30 Batch | 5.00 | 0.10 | 4.00 | 3 | 10 |
| Single Delivery Batch | 5.00 | 0.10 | 4.00 | 3 | 10 |
| Double Delivery Batch | 5.00 | 0.10 | 4.00 | 3 | 10 |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 5.00 | 0.10 | 4.00 | 3 | 10 |
| Stock-Up Batch | 10.00 | 0.05 | 6.00 | 3 | 15 |

## Drops

For every batch type a dropped batch earns nothing (the drop forfeits the pay). The drop reasons that carry no violation points are the same for every batch type: **store closed**, **app outage**, **vehicle breakdown** and **personal safety**.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Stock-Up Batch whose every order is canceled after 40 item units were already shopped earns cancellation pay of 10.00 plus 40 multiplied by 0.05, that is 2.00, for 12.00 in all. The same situation on a Double Delivery Batch gives 5.00 plus 40 multiplied by 0.10, that is 4.00, for 9.00.
